items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...picture of you, Tristano, Warne, and Ronnie Free . . . [INTERVIEWEE] In Canada?

ctx.x: I would think Warne and Ted would’ve been. I didn’t know Hal that well but its possible. I would say Hal was probably suggested by Jimmy. I had nothing to say about the rhythm section I remember.
The rhythm section, by the way, is Bill Evans, Buddy Clark, and the now legendary Ronnie Free.
